title: Why Grocery Shopping is Better in Amsterdam
summary: A four-minute Not Just Bikes comparison of grocery shopping in Amsterdam versus car-centric North America, arguing that frequent small fresh-food trips beat bulk shopping. It ties this to land use and reduced food waste.
why: Linked in urbanism and car-dependence threads as a concise case for walkable fresh-food shopping.

quote.text: had me pretty convinced land use was the key to breaking through a bad food waste vs shelf-stable food trade-off.
